describes: packages/plugin/actions: the javascript executor over a scripted sandbox, and the script surface door.

cases.name: a-script-node-is-one-transaction
cases.covers: The javascript executor prefetches the page world (fields, script-addressable annots with their styles and defaults), boots the name tree once, runs the node with Field x Mouse Up and the target value, and commits form effects then annotation effects.

cases.name: script-effects-commit
cases.covers: Form effects reach the form sink and annotation effects the annotation sink (object-number refs with their page, other refs as -1 without one).

cases.name: script-commit-failures
cases.covers: No form sink drops form effects with no-commit-sink; a form failure skips the annotation effects; no annotation sink drops them; an annotation failure fails the node.

args.message: script form effects dropped: no form commit sink registered (1)
script annot effects dropped: no annotation commit sink registered (1)
script annot effects skipped after form failure (1)
script commit: form effect 0: value refused
script annot effects skipped after form failure (1)
script annot effects dropped: no annotation commit sink registered (1)

cases.name: boot-effects-and-a-refetched-world
cases.covers: A boot that stages effects commits them in the first transaction, surfaces its UI effects as phase boot, and the run sees a refetched world; later nodes do not boot again.

cases.name: boot-without-effects
cases.covers: A boot output with nothing to commit does not refetch the world.

cases.name: run-errors-and-diagnostics
cases.covers: A run error fails the node with its message, after its diagnostics and error reach the script hooks; its effects are not committed.

cases.name: external-effects-run-after-the-transaction
cases.covers: print and submitForm UI effects from boot and run are held back and fired after the transaction (print through will-print/adapter/did-print, submit through the sink chain); alert and gotoPage surface inline.

cases.name: script-node-budget
cases.covers: maxScriptNodesPerDispatch caps JS nodes per dispatch: the rest are inert with the budget reason, and the next dispatch starts a fresh count.

cases.name: script-event-provenance
cases.covers: event.type and event.name from the trigger provenance: Field, Link, Annot, Page, Doc, and every annotation, page and document event name; a widget target by object number or name, with a value only for a scalar.

cases.name: no-page-to-anchor
cases.covers: A document with no pages has nothing to anchor the world on: the node is inert.

nodes.detail: no page to anchor the world on

diagnostics.message: javascript: no page to anchor the world on

args.message: javascript: no page to anchor the world on

cases.name: an-unknown-page-fails-the-node
cases.covers: A source page that is not in the document makes the world read throw; the transaction rejects and the node fails.

cases.name: environment-inputs
cases.covers: Configured now, UTC offset, seed, file name and a function identity reach every input; the defaults are the clock, zero, the FNV seed and the open name.

cases.name: environment-defaults
cases.covers: With nothing configured: Date.now() from the clock, a zero offset, seedFrom(documentId, sequence), the name the document was opened with, and the engine identity.

cases.name: environment-file-name-fallback
cases.covers: A document opened without a name is document.pdf to scripts.

cases.name: a-fault-rebuilds-the-realm
cases.covers: A sandbox that faults during a run is rebuilt and booted again for the next node.

cases.name: a-throwing-sandbox-fails-the-node
cases.covers: A sandbox run that throws rejects the transaction; the node fails with the message.

cases.name: budget-reaches-the-sandbox
cases.covers: A configured budget is the host default for every boot and run.

cases.name: no-sandbox-host
cases.covers: A host with no sandbox (the TypeScript with scripting disabled): javascript nodes are inert, scripting unavailable, and the capability has no scriptRealm member.

cases.name: script-transaction-port
cases.covers: With scripting on, the host lens has scriptRealm.transaction: a body shares the realm queue with the executor and resolves with the body result.

cases.name: closing-the-document-disposes-the-realm
cases.covers: Closing the document disposes the script realm and releases the event subscription.

cases.name: script-boot-without-a-catalog
cases.covers: A scripted document without the actions service, or whose catalog has no name-tree scripts, boots nothing.

cases.name: detached-script-realm
cases.covers: createDetachedScriptRealm mints a realm for another document under this document's environment: a fresh sandbox from the same factory, the target's id and metadata, the owner's identity, a seed from the target id, the target's boot sources, and the configured budget. The caller owns it: the transaction port queues bodies, and dispose ends the realm.

cases.name: detached-script-realm-without-metadata
cases.covers: A target with no document metadata runs as document.pdf with zero pages; with scripting off there is nothing to mint.

cases.name: no-detached-realm-without-scripting
cases.covers: With scripting off the host lens has no createDetachedScriptRealm, so a sibling mints nothing.

cases.name: scripting-disabled
cases.covers: javascript.enabled false: no realm, javascript nodes inert.

cases.name: surface-ui-effects
cases.covers: alert (with and without a title), gotoPage and print reach the adapter with the origin and phase; an adapter without alert or gotoPage ignores them; diagnostics and the error reach the script hooks.

cases.name: surface-refusals
cases.covers: No adapter is a no-adapter diagnostic; a print without doc.print is withheld with ui-effect-suppressed; a print during a document print event is suppressed as reentrant.

args.message: script alert: no UI adapter installed
script print request withheld: doc.print is not allowed
script print request during a document print event — suppressed (reentrant)

cases.name: surface-submit
cases.covers: A scripted submitForm from the form pipeline is detached through the same submit door (api source, activate event), with format fdf and method post by default and include-mode names.

cases.name: surface-a-detached-realm
cases.covers: A detached realm has no document surface: its print, gotoPage and submitForm requests are suppressed with ui-effect-suppressed, and only alerts reach the adapter.

args.message: script print request from a detached realm suppressed: no document surface
script gotoPage request from a detached realm suppressed: no document surface
script submitForm request from a detached realm suppressed: no document surface

cases.name: surface-script-commit
cases.covers: surfaceScriptCommit splits a K/V/C/F commit into its boot-phase effects (only when there are any) and its user-phase effects, which carry the diagnostics and the error even with no user effects; the realm kind rides both.

args.message: script print request from a detached realm suppressed: no document surface

cases.name: script-hooks-isolate-observers
cases.covers: A throwing onScriptDiagnostic or onScriptError observer is reported to the host sink.
